units.source_text: 古歌：“谁言无用物，废弃不须收？

en.t: An old poem says: Who says that something is useless, and that what has been cast aside need not be kept?

units.source_text: 手笔堪珍惜，千年遗念留。”

en.t: Handwriting is worth treasuring, for the feelings it leaves behind endure for a thousand years.
This is found in the Kokin Waka Rokucho.
